stem:
Esha measures the marked angle in the diagram. Its size is $210^{\circ}$.

Which claim about its type is correct?

options.text: The angle is obtuse, because it is greater than $90^{\circ}$.
The angle is acute, because $210$ is the only printed size on the diagram.
The angle is right, by treating a corner mark as $90^{\circ}$ no matter what size is labelled.

teacher.key_rationale: 210° lies between 180° and 360°, so the angle is reflex. Calling it obtuse drops the obtuse upper bound under 180°. Grabbing the printed 210 as “acute” is surface capture. Treating any corner as 90° conflates right-angle marking with measured size.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source right triangle as a marked 210° reflex angle.
